_description: Model Architecture Documentation - FaceMed CNN Skin Classifier

inputSpec.description: Batch of 1 image, 64 pixels height, 64 pixels width, 3 channels (RGB)

outputSpec.description: 5 probability scores (one per skin class) summing to 1.0

layers.name: conv2d_1
layers.purpose: Detects low-level visual features: edges, color gradients, and spot boundaries in skin images

layers.name: max_pooling2d_1
layers.purpose: Reduces spatial dimensions by 2x, retaining the strongest detected features and improving translation invariance

layers.name: conv2d_2
layers.purpose: Detects higher-level patterns: textures, shine regions, flake clusters, and pigmentation patches

layers.name: max_pooling2d_2
layers.purpose: Second spatial downsampling. Reduces noise and focuses on globally significant features

layers.name: flatten_1
layers.purpose: Converts the 3D feature map tensor into a 1D vector for input to the fully-connected dense layers

layers.name: dense_1
layers.purpose: Hidden layer that learns abstract combinations of visual features. Most of the model's classification power lives here

layers.name: dense_output
layers.purpose: Output layer. Converts the 32-unit representation to 5 probability scores — one per skin condition class

fullPipelineFlow.name: User Input
fullPipelineFlow.description: User uploads face image or enables webcam

fullPipelineFlow.name: Image Validation
fullPipelineFlow.description: Blur, resolution, lighting, and face presence checks

fullPipelineFlow.name: Preprocessing
fullPipelineFlow.description: Resize to 64x64, normalize pixels to [0,1], expand dims to [1,64,64,3]

fullPipelineFlow.name: Face Region Extract
fullPipelineFlow.description: Canvas crops the facial skin region into a 64x64 pixel segment

fullPipelineFlow.name: Feature Extraction
fullPipelineFlow.description: conv2d_1 and conv2d_2 extract edges, textures, spots, reflections

fullPipelineFlow.name: Classification
fullPipelineFlow.description: dense_output with softmax returns 5-class probability vector

fullPipelineFlow.name: Confidence Scoring
fullPipelineFlow.description: Highest probability class becomes the primary diagnosis

fullPipelineFlow.name: Severity Scoring
fullPipelineFlow.description: Confidence score mapped to mild/moderate/severe badge

fullPipelineFlow.name: Routine Generation
fullPipelineFlow.description: Morning and night routine steps fetched from metadata

fullPipelineFlow.name: Product Recommendation
fullPipelineFlow.description: 3 curated products matched to dominant skin condition
